tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba bzhugs so//

bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi yid la ci dgos slong rnams kyi// re ba sbyin pas 'dod pa gang mdzad la// dpag bsam shing las yon tan ches lhag pa'i// bcom ldan sgrol ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma la dad pas 'chi bdag gi bdud gzhom par 'dod pa dag gis/ dang por rjes su gnang ba thob par byas nas/ dben pa'i gnas su yar ngo'i tshes brgyad nas zla ba drug gi bar gyi cha rkyen tshang bar bsags/ rje btsun ma'i sku gzugs la mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa dang*/ chu gsum rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pa yid bzhin du bsham nas/tho rangs bde ba'i stan la kha lhor bltas te/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i snying gar pad dkar zla bas brgyan pa'i dbus su tāṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs gnyis padmo la btud cing*// 'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ tā re sa pa ri wā re arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai widye/ shaptas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi la sogs pa bdun rnam dag lan gsum bya/ badzra muḥtshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs/ sems can thams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi yid dang 'dre bar bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shu ddho ྅ haṃ/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/

paṃ las padma dkar po dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje chen pos sprul ba'i tāṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bsal/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba/ blta bas mi ngoms par mdzes pa'i sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil dang bcas pa'i spyan bdun ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis utpal dkar po'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung ba/ rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus me tog kha bye ba/ g.yas bud pa/ g.yon ma bye ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ lha'i dar zab kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs/ rin po che'i ske rags la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra thon mthing ltag par bcings pa'i lan bu thur du 'phyang ba/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can gyi pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer dkar po'i dbus na brjid pa'i snying gar zla ba'i 'khor lo 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba/ lte bar tāṃ yig dang*/ oṃ hā/ bar du bdag nyid kyi ming spel tshig dang bcas pas bskor ba/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ yi ge rnams kun da ltar dkar zhing gyen du langs pas gang bar bsams la/ ji srid yid mi skyo ba de srid du rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o// de nas/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags sgra ha cang mi che mi chung ring thung lhag chad med pa ma yengs par bzlas shing*/ 'khor lo las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad dag

'od zer phyir 'thon sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ thams cad sgrol mar gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sku gsung thugs dang*/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi rang bzhin 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byon nas/ yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsams pas/ ji tsam rnam par rtog pa mi 'phro ba de srid du bzlas nas/ mthar mdun gyi sku gzugs bcom ldan 'das mar dmigs la/ oṃ ārya tā re arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ /'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ tu ttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs bkra zhing*/ zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ utpal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lon pa'i lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin kun ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// yum gyur sgrol ma khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyed la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*/ nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyed kyis bskyab tu gsol/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// 'phags ma khyed la dad byed pa// de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs// bdag kyang khyed la gsol 'debs kyis// thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol// lha mo sku mdog zla ba'i mdog

/sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byed can// gzugs ldan rin chen rgyan gyis spras// mdzes pa'i dar gyi smad g.yogs can/ padma zla ba'i dbus gnas su// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung mdzad// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can// dus gsum sangs rgyas skyes pa'i yum// lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud// khyed la cha tsam bstod pa 'dis/ bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la// dus 'di nas gzung byang chub bar// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog/ ces dngos grub blangs la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /de yang*/ rmi lam du/ dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ chos thos pa dang*/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang mjal ba dang*// chu bo las thar ba dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ khrus byas pa dang*/ bud med mdzes ma'i dbus na 'dug pa dang*/ tsha tsha 'debs pa dang*/ mchod rten brtsig pa dang*/ mchod rten la bskor ba dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ utpal dkar po 'thu ba dang*/ sgrol ma'i sku gzugs rnyed pa dang mjal ba la sogs pa 'byung ba ni mtshan ma yin la/ mtshan ma rnyed nas bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg byas pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ grub pa'i mtshan ma ni/ tshangs pa khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba sbu'i rtse mo'ang bskyod mi nus// 'chi bdag las kyang grol bas na// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan nad// dbul ba la sogs skal ngan dang*// seng sogs 'jigs pa che brgyad kyi// duḥkha rab tu 'joms byed pa// bskul ba med par gos btung ba/ kha zas rin chen dag kyang 'du// ral gri dang ni mig sman dang*/ rkang mgyogs bum pa bzang sogs 'grub// tshigs bcad mkhas dang snyan dngags dang*// blo rno shes rab chen por 'gyur// gzhan yang ci 'dod dngos grub ni// 'khor lo de las 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so// gzhan rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas/

dben pa'i gnas su padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bris la/ dbus su tshom bu bkod/ bum pa tshad ldan bum sman sbyar ba'i chus sum gnyis bkang ba/ dar dkar pos mgul bcings pa dbus su bzhag mchod gtor gyis mtha' bskor/ bdag bskyed byas/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ rdul tshon gyi dbus dang bum pa'i nang du/ paṃ las padma dkar po nas/ 'od zer dkar po'i dbus na brjid pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i cha stod du hūṃ/ cha smad yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo tāṃ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ steng gi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ ārya tā re arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swā hā nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod / badzra aṅku sha dzaḥbadzra pa sha hūṃ/ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ badzra ā be sha ya a/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bsres/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyis dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa swā hā nas sha'i bar gyis mchod/ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥbadzra pa sha hūṃ/ badzra sphoṭa baṃ/ badzra ā be sha ya a/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bsres/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyis dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu ma 'aṃ gyis gsol ba btab/ lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs kyis dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma lud pa las/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas gong gi mdun bskyed bzhin mchod bstod byas/ bsnyen pa ji ltar rigs pa byas pa'i sngags 'phreng bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim par bsam zhing*/ mthar 'od du zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// de nas rin po che'i snod du gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/

snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi btags la lan bdun gyis phul/ de nas/ slob mas khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ maṇḍal phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can gyis gsol ba btab/ bla ma sgrol ma dkar mo gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blangs/ dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad bsal nas/ rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ swa bhā wa nas gyen du langs pas gang bar bsams la zhes pa'i bar gyis slob ma lhar bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'khor lo dang yig 'bru'i rnam par byon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa dang bcas pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim yig 'bru'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad dag par bsams la rol mo'i sgra bsgrog go/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dngos su bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ārya tā ra la sogs pas mchod/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā sa me tog gtor ba sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo las sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung ba zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs/ snying ga'i yig 'bru la thim pa'i

mos pa gyis/ snying po'i sngags rjes zlos kyi mthar/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nus pa brtan par mdzad du gsol// de nas/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// padma'i steng gi tshom bu slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag bcom ldan 'das ma khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas/ sku gsung thugs dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhog cig thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// ces zlos su gzhug gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul lo// de ltar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i mthu bo'i rgya gzhung dang*/ rjes gnang bla ma'i phyag bzhes sor bzhag pa/ dge slong padma dkar pos dben gnas mkhar chur sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// //
